title: fixed-association coherent comparison equation
statement: For a fixed balanced scalar association, the direct and successive coherent reduction comparisons satisfy the counit naturality equation, using [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus].

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: Use naturality of the coherent counit in the derived system category, then substitute the successive system isomorphism and the three completion identifications. The equality is checked before evaluation, so it holds at every derived object K.
